keywords: 取出;拆下;拆开;拆卸;洗碗机;dishwasher;remove the pump;removable pump
must_show_en: the removable top unit with the pump is lifted off and set aside on the counter, away from the water; only the open, empty basin is being washed
must_not_en: washing the basin while the top unit is still attached; the top unit or the pump under running water or soaking
note: 清洗要先拆：事实里写了取出、拆、洗碗机，画面必须是拆开的状态，电源部分离开水；45° 俯拍看清空盆在水槽里

keywords: 清洗;易清洗;好清洗;冲洗;擦拭;rinse;wipe;easy to clean
must_show_en: a real cleaning action on the outer surface of the assembled product: a hand wiping or rinsing it
must_not_en: parts taken apart or laid out; the product put in a dishwasher
note: 事实只说好清洗、没说能拆时，画面不拆，只拍擦拭或冲洗外表

must_show_en: a pet arriving close to the outlet and a thin stream of water visibly starting to flow from the outlet
must_not_en: a glowing beam, icon or light showing the sensor; still water with no flow
note: 感应要拍出「靠近了，水开始流」这一刻；低机位、宠物视线高度最有代入感

keywords: 流水;出水;定时出水;持续出水;安静;静音;分贝;dB;quiet;flow
must_show_en: water visibly flowing from the outlet, with soft ripples spreading across the water surface
must_not_en: completely still, motionless water; no visible flow
note: 讲水流、安静、定时、持续出水的图，画面里必须看得见水在流；侧面或 45° 逆侧光最能拍出水流；安静可以用全景拍宠物在旁边睡

keywords: 水位;水位窗;加水;water level;water window;refill
must_show_en: the water level clearly readable through the water window
must_not_en: a glowing window; numbers or scale marks added on the window
note: 讲水位就让水位窗里的水位看得清；水位窗在正面，所以这一类允许正面

must_show_en: a generous amount of clear water filling most of the basin
must_not_en: an empty or nearly empty basin; measuring cups or scale lines
note: 讲容量时盆里要有很多水；俯拍看水面最直观

must_show_en: the brushed steel texture catching a band of light, with fine grain visible
must_not_en: a mirror-like chrome finish; a changed colour or material
note: 讲材质要看得见拉丝纹理；侧光微距

keywords: 水泵;滤芯;过滤;循环;电池;毫安;battery;filter;pump;circulat
must_show_en: the outer product exactly as in the references
must_not_en: internal parts that are not listed in the product card's internal structure
note: 讲内部的东西（水泵、滤芯、电池、水循环）可以考虑透视或剖视特效，但只能画产品卡「内部结构」里确认过的部件；不清楚就问用户
